BREAKING — Jai Garner was arrested Tuesday afternoon, October 20, 2026, at 2:00 p.m., on a felony criminal mischief charge, according to Webb County booking records.

Garner was booked into the Webb County Jail on one count of criminal mischief involving pecuniary loss of $2,500 to under $30,000 (charge code CRIMINAL MISCHIEF ≥$2,500<$30K) — a state jail felony under Texas law. Bond was set at $5,000.

A state jail felony in Texas is punishable by 180 days to two years in a state jail facility and a fine of up to $10,000. The records reviewed by Webb Watch 956 do not describe the alleged damage or where it allegedly occurred, and the booking record does not list an arresting agency — the holding-agency field was blank.

Webb Watch 956 will follow this case as it moves through the Webb County courts.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Jai Garner is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Update — October 29, 2026

Garner was arraigned in the 111th District Court on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, according to Webb County public-access court records. Judge Monica Z. Notzon presided; Garner appeared in custody, waived formal reading of the indictment, pleaded not guilty, and requested trial settings. The court set an informal pre-trial for January 20, 2027, at 2:00 p.m.; a pre-trial hearing for February 16, 2027, at 9:00 a.m.; a final pre-trial for March 22, 2027, at 9:00 a.m.; and jury selection for April 5, 2027, at 8:00 a.m. No disposition is shown, and the case remains active. Court records also show an earlier arraignment on October 13, 2026, at which Garner did not appear, leading to a capias; the warrant was served on October 20, 2026.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Oct. 20, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal (Oct. 29, 2026 check: Oct. 27, 2026 arraignment and trial settings, case 2026CRO001124D2).
